title: EDG Community Update: Feb 14th, 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- Edgeware’s solochain mainnet became 2 years old on 17th Feb 2022. The self-sustainability experiment turned stability-oriented public ecosystem has entered into the third year with several teams and solo individuals as contributors!
- The new [runtime developer, Filip Kalebo has been onboarded](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1494295708303859720?s=20&t=jynyPY9STGrUjOIqu5aIOA) by the community.
- [The crowdloan waitlist](https://kabocha.network/) is open for Kabocha.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP5/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP5/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Over the last 90 days, the [EDG staking percentage has increased by 11.69%](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1494279547767898115?s=20&t=jynyPY9STGrUjOIqu5aIOA), strengthening the Edgeware solochain’s network security.
- PJS summarized Kabocha in his vision aka ‘[Subversive Metaversing](https://twitter.com/EdgewareChain/status/1493479937218850816?s=20&t=jynyPY9STGrUjOIqu5aIOA)’ phenomenon into a subsocial article.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-feb-13/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures have opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops
